description: This file defines internal interfaces and classes related to connection features and transport connection management within the Orleans networking framework. It includes feature interfaces, their implementation in the TransportConnection class, and mechanisms for managing feature collection states.

classes.name: IConnectionIdFeature
classes.description: Interface representing a connection to hold its connection ID.

classes.name: IConnectionItemsFeature
classes.description: Interface representing a collection for connection-specific items.

classes.name: IMemoryPoolFeature
classes.description: Interface for access to a memory pool used within the connection.

classes.name: TransportConnection
classes.description: Partial class implementing multiple connection features and managing feature collection logic.

methods.name: FastReset
methods.description: Resets internal references to the transport connection itself and clears extra features.

methods.name: ResetFeatureCollection
methods.description: Resets the feature collection state to initial, clearing extra features and updating revision.

methods.name: ExtraFeatureGet
methods.description: Retrieves an extra feature by type from the additional features list.

methods.name: ExtraFeatureSet
methods.description: Adds or updates an extra feature in the list of additional features.
